description: Generated-PDF sub-corpus the Tier-3 eval command loads from evals/corpus/generated-pdf/manifest.json. The DoclingPdfAdapter STUB synthesises a _DoclingDocument from each PDF; the chunk anchors named in the manifest are surfaced through that synthesis so the golden queries can score against them. The on-disk PDFs are 10/100/600-page fixtures generated by scripts/generate_pdf_fixtures.py.

chunks.text: Table of constraints (10-page fixture): the table on page 4 lists the canonical constraints enforced by the platform. Headers: Constraint, Source, ValidFrom, ValidTo, Severity. The 10-page PDF is a sanitised fixture; the table content is the canonical reference for the eval corpus.
Constraints table header: Constraint | Source | ValidFrom | ValidTo | Severity. The header row is preserved across every table split (Change Package E6: table headers repeat on split).

Architecture diagram (100-page fixture, page 7): the figure shows the canonical project intelligence platform architecture with retrieval, chunking, ingestion and Control Plane layers. Sanitised content; the figure is the canonical reference for the generated-pdf architecture eval query.
Figure caption: 'Figure 7.1: Canonical project intelligence platform architecture.' The caption is the canonical anchor for the figure-related eval queries.

Table of contents (600-page fixture, page 1): the table of contents lists the canonical section structure of the platform architecture document. The 600-page PDF is a synthesised fixture; the TOC is the canonical reference for the long-document eval query.
